question: Among evidences given the SAME verdict, does the verdict-token logit margin rank gold-correct above gold-incorrect?

probe.not_the_shipped_probe: A bare-word variant, required because mlx_lm.server does not honour the assistant prefill. It is NOT in probes.battery.PROBES and has no fitted calibration. No statement here is a result about pol.verdict_direct.

incumbent_cross_stack.note: shipped evidence-grain arm llm-gemma-4-26b, scored on Bedrock WITH deliberation -- cross-stack, see docstring

within_verdict.note: THE strict test. Chance (0.5) means the margin varies without tracking correctness.

prior_measurement.config: post-CoT p_raw on the production prompt
prior_measurement.relation: a DIFFERENT configuration; this run tests a no-reasoning bare-word probe at n>=4000

held_out_combination.design: out-of-fold logistic combination on the panel's frozen fold_id, scored PER FOLD and size-weighted -- never pooled across folds
held_out_combination.cross_stack_note: shipped evidence-grain arm llm-gemma-4-26b, scored on Bedrock WITH deliberation -- cross-stack, see docstring
held_out_combination.pooling_artifact_note: Pooled across folds the incumbent-only arm reads ~0.814 against a raw-score AUROC of ~0.835, because ten separately scaled logistic fits do not share a ranking. Per-fold scoring removes that artifact; the pooled form would have inflated every delta below.
held_out_combination.verdict: the MARGIN adds beyond a second verdict
held_out_combination.why_this_gates: A within-verdict AUROC above chance does not imply held-out gain; see project_deliberation_length_signal, where it did not.

bootstrap.design: fold-stratified paired bootstrap, one shared index vector; conditional on frozen predictions
